reviews.x: Great purchase.  I have a growth pattern on the back of my head that exposes scalp.  I am over 70 and have range of motion problems as well as not being able to style my own hair.  I put these in the problem area, slept comfortably all night and a quick comb through the next morning gave me the coverage and look I wanted.  Highly recommend these.  Love them.  Would order again if necessary.
Works exactly as described.  No issues whatsoever.

reviews.t: If you are looking for beautiful Shirley Temple-esque curls these are great
reviews.x: I am giving these 3 stars because they promised to give beach waves but they give very bouncy curls. If you are looking for beautiful Shirley Temple-esque curls these are great!  They are comfortable to sleep in and they are gentle on the hair.

reviews.t: These are great! I slept in them and the curls were ...
reviews.x: These are great! I slept in them and the curls were way too tight, so the next time I rolled damp hair (fairly dry, really) and set them for an hour. The curls were wonderful and bouncy!

Good product, wrong hair! My hair doesn't keep a curl. On a good note though, my cat truly loves these. He's commandeered several and pushes them under doors, appliances to play with. Endlessly adorable.

One curler defective found when I tried to use and exposed metal poked my scalp. Regardless of plastic tip it hurt. Now another one as an exposed wire. It appears these are not going no to last very low long, very disappointed!
I love it! Why only 4 stars? Coz it's time consuming 😂

I absolutely love these curlers!  I use them at night and they're perfectly comfortable to sleep on.  I hate how a lot of curlers leave the 1/4 inch or so of my hair uncurled, so I bought a pack of end papers and use those.  The curls come out smooth and shiny!  If you have a lot of hair, I would recommend getting two sets.

reviews.t: Fast shipper and terrific curlers. I highly recommend both seller and curlers
reviews.x: Fast shipper and terrific curlers.  I highly recommend both seller and curlers.  I have thin long hair and have had so much trouble keeping curls in my hair.  These curlers solved my problem and the're easy to roll in your hair too, also comfortable.  You can even sleep in them because they are so spongy.  I love them so much I'm going to buy another set of them just in case they stop selling them.

I have never written a review on here before but wanted to for these.  I have a short bob hair cut and because of damaged hair I can't style with heat. I wanted these for another styling, no heat option. They get 5 stars for curl. They certainly do that. But I look like I have a perm and with my damaged ends it looks horrendous. I will give them one more try by putting more hair in one curler and not rolling them so tight. If that doesn't work I'll be returning them. I think these would be great
You DO NOT get those soft waves as advertised. The curls come out so tight that they look horrible. I returned them.

I have long hair that is naturally curly and beautiful right after washed and left to air dry, but the next morning if I brush through the curls, I get frizz.  So I decided to try these for the overnight after spritzing some water mixed with a small amount of conditioner.  At first I tried rolling them up against the scalp as in the picture and I came out with Shirley Temple curls.  Curls that were impossible to comb your fingers through to try to tame. reviews.t: Awesome, but need 2 or 3 for really thick hair
reviews.x: Love these curlers. I have wavy, thick hair that can be frizzy, so these curlers make for tighter curls with less frizz. I put them in at night with wet hair and wake up with nice curls. You can't wrap them with a fist full of hair or your hair will not dry. If it does not dry, the curls will not be great. Hence, my 4 stars because these curlers only do about 1/3 of my head of hair.  Now I do have really, really thick hair. The kind when you go in for a trim and the stylist runs his fingers thru

reviews.t: Great product - but the small size will give you TIGHT curls.
reviews.x: Soft but good quality and they hold their place. Plus, you receive A LOT of them. They are on the small side so you end up with pretty tight curls if you're not careful. I wish they came in a bigger size so I could use them more often.
I must not be putting them in tight enough b/c they fall out. When they stay in the curls look nice. I need to try it wet.

I have NEVER had anything curl my hair besides a curling iron.  Well it would curl it, but it would only last about an hour and then fall out.  I have to agree with others when they said it gives tight curls, but I had no problem with that.  That wavy look in the product picture, had to be blow dried or only kept on for a few hours, because there is no way they would come out like that.  I took a shower and then put them in.  I used no styling products, because I hate them.  20 come in the packa

reviews.t: Great idea but curler is just too small
reviews.x: These curlers are for short hair only.  My hair isn't to my shoulders and I couldn't get the hair to wrap around the curler because it was too long.  I don't understand why they have a picture of a girl with long hair.  They are very hard to work with and most of them fell out.  Great idea but curler is just too small.  Had to return.
Exactly what I was looking for.  Super comfy to sleep in.  Very pleased with my purchase.

Very comfy to sleep on, and very soft, they definitely do the job. However, I used quite a bit of my hair per curler and still got VERY tight spiral curls, not beachy waves. If you want super curly hair these are great. But after two attempts, I am returning. My hair looked permed. No thanks!

Well... my first use was a disaster. I must have wrapped my hair too tight or it was too damp because I had the most crazy, kinky, frizzy hair that was no where remotely a cute curl. I ended up having to hot iron all of my hair which tamed some of the frizz.  I recently received instructions from the company with some how to's.  Wish those actually came with the product when delivered instead of a week or so later. So, needless to say, this is still a work in progress and will update my review i

Although they aren't "soft as angels' wings" for sleeping on, these curlers are definitely the softest I've tried.  I use them for overnight curls--it makes styling a breeze in the morning.  As my hair is very short,  I like a curly style and these give me just that.  Really though,  the curl my hair gets from these soft curlers is pretty similar to that given by old fashioned foam rollers.  All in all, I am very happy with my purchase. reviews.t: Like them except the wires are a little long but ...
reviews.x: Like them except the wires are a little long but they do a great job holding the curls even when sleeping you do not feel them so soft like little pillows.

They are fantastic do the best job exactly as they say able to sleep in them can not say enough great things highly recommend these rollers for easy style of hair roll and go to bed. I have NO hair style skills, wash and go. These rollers have made my hair look great and so many complements from friends and co works of how great my hair looks. I have recommend these rollers and told everyone that is what iam doing with my hair. All you girls that wash and go natural try these rollers.

I am extremely disappointed in this product. My hair came out nothing like the model’s hair in the picture. The curls were tight and horizontal not vertical and loose like the model’s hair in the picture.  I’m completely dissatisfied and I feel like the description and picture were very deceiving.

reviews.t: Maybe more practice is needed but I was sad to find these didn't work well on my shoulder-length
reviews.x: Really disappointing. I was hoping to wear these at night and wake up with luscious curls, instead I just had these wild kinky, curl-like forms. Maybe more practice is needed but I was sad to find these didn't work well on my shoulder-length, fine hair.

claims.text: Many reviewers find these curlers comfortable to sleep in and effective for overnight curls.
Several reviewers report the curls come out much tighter than expected, not the soft beach waves advertised.
Some reviewers note durability and quality problems, including defective curlers with exposed metal or wire.
A few reviewers mention the curlers can be time consuming or may fall out if not rolled tightly enough.
Some reviewers with thick or long hair note they need more curlers or larger sizes for best results.
